ADR-0128 item 8 authorizes positive durable recommendation facts. Candidates come from an incrementally maintained indexed projection through a hard-capped request window. Eligibility is applied inside that window; exhaustion returns a typed 503 instead of a falsely empty response or an unbounded tail scan. HTTP and scale regressions prove correct results through a 2,001-row category-heavy prefix and bounded failure beyond 4,096 candidates.
